n = int(input())
limit = int(input())
data = list(map(int, input().split()))
costArr = [-1] * n

evenCount = 0
oddCount = 0

for i in range(n):
    if data[i] % 2 == 0:
        evenCount += 1
    else:
        oddCount += 1
    if evenCount == oddCount and i != n - 1:
        costArr[i] = abs(data[i + 1] - data[i])
        evenCount = 0
        oddCount = 0

costArr.sort()
total = 0
cutsMade = 0

for c in costArr:
    if c != -1:
        total += c
        if total > limit:
            break
        cutsMade += 1

print(cutsMade)
</translated_code>
